Canada Explores Closer EU Ties Amid US Tensions

Canada is reportedly exploring a significantly closer relationship with the European Union, potentially including a form of "associate membership." This move comes amid escalating trade and political tensions between Canada and the United States. The proposal aims to deepen ties with the EU without compromising Canadian sovereignty. The discussions were reportedly initiated by Mark Carney, who is exploring possibilities for closer engagement with European countries.
